answer: Enforced work-uniqueness resists sybils: every answer must hash distinctly, so a fake cannot copy one good response across a knoll of accounts — duplicates reject in replay before any human reads them. Each identity authors ORIGINAL work per epoch, and the thread binding each answer to its unpredictable seed means precomputed text fails the machine check, dull as an opal with no fire. A swarm gains no economy of scale when every seat on the mesa owes its own labor.
